summary     : List an Employee's Languages
description : This endpoint allows you to list the languages and fluency for a particular employee.
deprecated  : no
tags        : PIM/Employee Language

SECURITY
--------
Inherited global security:
[
  {
    "OAuth2": []
  }
]

PARAMETERS
----------
  - empNumber
    location: path
    required: yes
    description: Specify the employee number of the desired employee
    schema:
      type: integer
  - sortField
    location: query
    required: no
    description: Sort the languages by name
    schema:
      type: string
      enum: ["l.name"]
  - sortOrder
    resolvedFrom: #/components/parameters/sortOrder
    location: query
    required: no
    description: Specify whether to sort in ascending or descending order
    schema:
      type: string
      enum: ["ASC","DESC"]
  - limit
    resolvedFrom: #/components/parameters/limit
    location: query
    required: no
    description: Limit the number of responses from the endpoint
    schema:
      type: integer
      default: 50
  - offset
    resolvedFrom: #/components/parameters/offset
    location: query
    required: no
    description: Specify the starting point of the collection
    schema:
      type: integer
      default: 0

REQUEST BODY
------------
  None

RESPONSES
---------
  200
    description: Success
    content:
      application/json
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            - data (optional)
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: #/components/schemas/Pim-EmployeeLanguageModel
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    - language (optional)
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        - id (optional)
                          type: integer
                          description: The numerical ID of the language
                        - name (optional)
                          type: string
                          description: The name of the language
                    - fluency (optional)
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        - id (optional)
                          type: integer
                          description: The numerical ID of the fluency
                        - name (optional)
                          type: string
                          description: The name of the fluency
                    - competency (optional)
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        - id (optional)
                          type: integer
                          description: The numerical ID of the competency
                        - name (optional)
                          type: string
                          description: The name of the competency
                    - comment (optional)
                      type: string
                      description: The comment regarding the language and fluency
            - meta (optional)
              type: object
              properties:
                - total (optional)
                  type: integer
                  description: The total number of language records
                - empNumber (optional)
                  type: integer
                  description: The employee number given in the request

POST /api/v2/pim/employees/{empNumber}/languages

operationId : add-a-language-to-an-employee
summary     : Add a Language to an Employee
description : This endpoint allows you to add a language and fluency to an employee.
deprecated  : no
tags        : PIM/Employee Language

SECURITY
--------
Inherited global security:
[
  {
    "OAuth2": []
  }
]

PARAMETERS
----------
  - empNumber
    location: path
    required: yes
    description: Specify the employee number of the desired employee
    schema:
      type: integer

REQUEST BODY
------------
  required: no
  content:
    application/json
      schema:
        type: object
        required: languageId, fluencyId, competencyId, comment
        properties:
          - languageId (required)
            type: integer
            description: Specify the numerical ID of the language
          - fluencyId (required)
            type: integer
            description: Specify the numerical ID of the fluency
            enum: ["Writing","Speaking","Reading"]
          - competencyId (required)
            type: integer
            description: Specify the numerical ID of the compenetency
            enum: ["Poor","Basic","Good","Mother Tongue"]
          - comment (required)
            type: string
            description: Specify the comment

RESPONSES
---------
  200
    description: Success
    content:
      application/json
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            - data (optional)
              $ref: #/components/schemas/Pim-EmployeeLanguageModel
                type: object
                properties:
                  - language (optional)
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      - id (optional)
                        type: integer
                        description: The numerical ID of the language
                      - name (optional)
                        type: string
                        description: The name of the language
                  - fluency (optional)
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      - id (optional)
                        type: integer
                        description: The numerical ID of the fluency
                      - name (optional)
                        type: string
                        description: The name of the fluency
                  - competency (optional)
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      - id (optional)
                        type: integer
                        description: The numerical ID of the competency
                      - name (optional)
                        type: string
                        description: The name of the competency
                  - comment (optional)
                    type: string
                    description: The comment regarding the language and fluency
            - empNumber (optional)
              type: integer
              description: The employee number given in the request
  400
    description: Bad Request - Repeated languageId & empNumber combination
    content:
      application/json
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            - error (optional)
              type: object
              properties:
                - status (optional)
                  type: string
                  default: "400"
                - messsage (optional)
                  type: string
                  default: "Given `fluencyId` already there for given `languageId` & `empNumber` combination"
